characters.name: Lead Girl (newly turned freshman)
characters.want: Keep control as the change hits—she braces on the sink, searches her own face for something stable, then later uses the coven’s momentum to feel powerful instead of sick.
characters.mask: Dead-eyed cool; lets her body language say she’s fine even when she’s not.
characters.tell: Her grip whitens on edges (sink/ledge), breath turns shallow, and she locks eyes with the lens like she’s daring it to flinch first.
characters.appearance: College-age; porcelain skin under harsh fluorescents; preppy-uniform styling corrupted (loosened tie, smeared eyeliner, crucifix choker); later: mouth bloodied, eyes molten-gold.

characters.name: Boy 1 (fanged runner)
characters.want: Prove he’s dangerous enough to belong—he bares fangs and takes point when the night turns predatory.
characters.mask: Predator swagger; performs fearlessness through stillness before the snarl.
characters.tell: Jaw ticks right before fangs show; nostrils flare like he’s scenting blood.
characters.appearance: College-age; lean, shirtless in a motel corridor; skin wet with something dark; gold-amber eyes when lit.

characters.name: Boy 2 (watcher at the window)
characters.want: Track the lead girl’s transformation and claim a place beside her—he watches first, then joins the rooftop line as commitment.
characters.mask: Observant calm; lets distance read as control.
characters.tell: Eyes lock too long; shoulders tense when he’s seen.
characters.appearance: College-age; uniform elements (varsity jacket, loosened tie); eyes flare amber behind frosted glass.

characters.name: Skirt Girl (casual killer)
characters.want: Keep her appetite hidden in plain sight—maintain normalcy while standing over the evidence.
characters.mask: Bored, everyday texting posture; performs indifference.
characters.tell: A quick lick at blood on her lip/chin before she looks back down at her phone.
characters.appearance: College-age; pleated school skirt; blood on chin; phone in hand; posture relaxed over a body in an empty lot.

narrative_shape: Ramp montage that keeps revealing higher stakes until a silence-and-stare release into the title.

clips.description: Three silhouettes advance across a brutalist college quad at magic hour, red sunset bleeding behind palm trees; they walk like they already own the night.
Extreme close-up: the lead girl’s pupils dilate; her iris shifts from brown to molten gold as veins bloom around her lash-line.
She stumbles into a dorm bathroom and grips the sink; the fluorescent tube flickers as her reflection lags half a second behind—she tests the mirror like it might confess what she’s becoming.
A single black tear of blood tracks down her cheek; she holds herself upright, trying not to look frightened by her own face.
Beat-drop energy: the coven emerges from a neon-soaked dive bar—lead girl center-frame, two boys flanking; cigarette smoke curls between them as they move like a unit.
A shirtless boy in a motel corridor under a buzzing VACANCY sign—chest wet with something dark—turns and shows a gold-fanged snarl, making the predatory truth explicit.

A whip-pan across a house party—bodies writhing in strobes—punches into a close-up of fangs descending; lips part around them in almost erotic surrender as the moment becomes a choice, not an accident.
The three sprint across a parking garage rooftop, inhumanly fast; motion blur and distance collapse as the world fails to keep up with them.
The lead girl leaps impossibly high; the camera tilts up with her into the moon—control turns to hunger, exhilaration turns to inevitability.

Ritual montage: an ornate vial of amber liquid is held between manicured fingers; a boy’s glowing amber eyes lock with the camera through a frosted classroom window; over it, the pitched-down vocal sample lands verbatim:

A girl in a pleated school skirt stands over a body in an empty parking lot, blood on her chin, texting casually; cut to the coven shoulder-to-shoulder on a rooftop ledge, hoods up against a blood moon, ready to drop—then strobing flash-frames (fang, eye, neon sign, wrist, moon) slam into black.
Total silence. A single frame holds on the lead girl—mouth bloody, gold eyes wet, breathing—staring directly into the lens. Whispered, almost a laugh, verbatim:
The title BLOODRUSH slams in, one droplet of blood sliding down the R—subsonic bass hit—black.

genre_engine.genre: Neon Gothic vampire college drama (horror-romance hybrid)
genre_engine.story_engine: A new hunger collides with the need to belong; intimacy becomes predation, and the campus social machine turns supernatural initiation into status and danger.
genre_engine.resolution_form: Irreversible initiation signaled by a public-facing stare and the coven’s readiness to ‘drop.’

user_facing: A freshman’s body betrays her: eyes turn molten-gold, a black tear falls, and even her reflection can’t keep up. Then the night detonates—neon streets, a coven moving as one, fangs bared, bodies surrendering, and a sprint that feels too fast to be human. A vial flashes like a promise or a threat, blood appears with shocking casualness, and the trio stands on a rooftop ledge under a blood moon, ready to fall into whatever they’ve become. scope_assessment.scope_note: At 12 seconds, the teaser’s many micro-events read as pure sensation with no room for reaction beats, so the infection-to-ritual escalation can’t land emotionally—only visually.
scope_assessment.narrow_slice_suggestion: Keep only ‘The Infection’ in the dorm bathroom (eye change → reflection lag → black tear), ending on her first locked stare into the mirror as the button.
